spotlight.title: NIST Project Aims to Accelerate Mobile Driver’s License Adoption
spotlight.summary: Mobile driver’s licenses could help U.S. citizens do business more securely, but there are few ways to use them — an issue the project is designed to help address.

digest.summary: What creates the colors in Jupiter's clouds? No one is sure.
